model.title: Rural Obstetrics Readiness Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would create and expand federal grant programs to help rural hospitals and areas lacking obstetric specialists improve their emergency childbirth care. It aims to fund workforce training, equipment purchases, and telehealth programs to ensure pregnant women in underserved rural areas have access to emergency obstetric services.
